The Brief

Rosewood Bourbon is a conceptual spirits brand developed as part of LVC's Corporate Branding course. The project explores what a refined, high-end bourbon brand could look like when rooted in tradition but presented with a modern sensibility. The work includes logo design, product and label design, stationery, and web design. Particular emphasis was placed on crafting a strong, timeless logo and visual system that communicates luxury, craftsmanship, and depth-setting the tone for the entire brand experience.
